# sync-status

Both unhealthy phases (`warning`, `error`) render the SAME action set, chosen
only by the classified code's remediation: the phase decides how loud the banner
looks, never whether the user is given a way out. Don't key the fix affordance
off `error` alone — that silently strips it the day a reconnect-able failure is
classified non-terminal.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Mail sync-status banner: a full-width strip above the mailbox surface that surfaces in-progress syncs and classified sync failures (warning/error) with remediation copy and actions (reconnect, enable API, retry). Silent when the mailbox is healthy.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `Mail.Banner` → `MailSyncBanner`
    - `Mail.RailBadge` → `MailSyncDot`
  - Uses:
    - `apps/mail/shell.Mail`
    - `infra/endpoints.useEndpointMutation`
    - `integrations/gmail.GmailAccessAction`
    - `primitives/css/fill.Fill`
    - `primitives/css/inline.Inline`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/spinner.Spinner`
    - `primitives/css/status-dot.StatusDot`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.Button`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.cn`
    - `primitives/live-state.useResource`
